gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.body: Log a period start in the Tracker and your fertility status will appear here.

worthKnowing.title: Worth knowing
worthKnowing.body: You logged an NSAID/painkiller close to this cycle's fertile window. They're linked to suppressed ovulation around that time — worth mentioning to your doctor before your next cycle.

lh.label: LH
lh.startBuilding: Log a strip test today to start building this read.

mucus.label: Cervical mucus
mucus.detail: Logged from the Tracker screen — mucus consistency is one of the earliest fertility signs.

temp.label: Basal temperature
temp.coverline: Your coverline is {{value}}°C — three readings at or above it confirm a shift.
temp.keepLogging: Keep logging a waking temperature — a coverline needs a few mornings of baseline first.

lhLeadTime.title: Why LH has less lead time than mucus

Menstrual.explainer: "A time for inward reflection, deep rest, and honoring your body's sacred reset."

hormones.title: The Great Reset
hormones.detail: Estrogen and progesterone hit their monthly nadir to trigger the shed. This 'biological winter' is a vital system reboot, not a shutdown.
hormones.protocol: Protect your energy. Magnesium glycinate (200-400mg) can soothe cramps and support deep restorative sleep tonight.

mind.title: Intuitive Clarity
mind.detail: Communication between brain hemispheres is strongest now. It's the perfect time for evaluating your path and setting intentions.
mind.protocol: Journaling tonight is non-negotiable. Your intuition is louder than logic right now, listen to it.

body.title: Active Recovery
body.detail: Your body is working hard to release. High intensity will backfire by spiking cortisol when resilience is low.
body.protocol: Focus on Gentle Yoga or a slow 20-minute walk. Keep your lower back and feet warm to support circulation.

skin.title: Hydration Barrier
skin.detail: Low estrogen means less natural oil and moisture retention. Your skin barrier is more permeable and sensitive.
skin.protocol: Skip the harsh exfoliants. Layer a hydrating serum with a rich ceramide moisturizer to lock in water.

Follicular.explainer: "A season of renewal. Your energy blooms and creative potential awakens."

hormones.title: The Awakening
hormones.detail: FSH stimulates new follicles, and estrogen begins to climb. This neuro-stimulant hormone lifts your mood, energy, and mental speed.
hormones.protocol: Capitalize on this rising energy. Schedule your most demanding creative work for the morning hours.

mind.title: Architect Mode
mind.detail: You are primed for learning and complex problem solving. Brain fog clears as you become open to new ideas and social connection.
mind.protocol: Tackle that complex project you've been putting off. Your brain is hungry for challenge.

body.title: Building Power
body.detail: Your body is ready to burn carbs for fuel and build muscle. Recovery time is faster now than at any other time.
body.protocol: Increase cardio intensity or heavy lifting. Your body can handle the stress and bounce back stronger.

skin.title: Collagen Bloom
skin.detail: Rising estrogen boosts collagen and hyaluronic acid production. Your skin is naturally more resilient and glowing.
skin.protocol: A great time for a vitamin C serum to amplify that natural glow. You can tolerate more active treatments now.

Ovulatory.explainer: "Peak vitality. You are radiant, communicative, and vibrating with confidence."

hormones.title: The Main Event
hormones.detail: The biological zenith. Estrogen peaks to trigger ovulation, while testosterone gives you a surge of confidence and libido.
hormones.protocol: You are magnetic. Schedule dates, pitches, or difficult conversations. You are chemically wired to persuade.

mind.title: Social Butterfly
mind.detail: Your verbal skills and emotional intelligence are at their height. You are more articulate and persuasive.
mind.protocol: Network, present, or record content. Your ability to connect with others is at its peak.

body.title: Peak Performance
body.detail: Testosterone adds a strength boost. You are at your strongest, but your ligaments are also looser (higher injury risk).
body.protocol: Go for a PR in the gym, but watch your form. High-intensity interval training (HIIT) is highly effective now.

skin.title: Radiant but Oily
skin.detail: Sebum production increases slightly. You look vibrant, but pores may be more visible due to the surge.
skin.protocol: Double cleanse in the evenings. Using a clay mask can help manage the extra oil without stripping your glow.

Luteal.explainer: "The inward turn. A time for nesting, deep focus, and profound intuition."

hormones.title: The Shift
hormones.detail: Estrogen drops and progesterone rises. This has a sedative, calming effect, but withdrawal later triggers PMS.
hormones.protocol: Prioritize stability. Eat regular meals with protein to stabilize blood sugar and combat mood swings.

mind.title: Deep Focus
mind.detail: Brain chemistry shifts from social/expansive to internal/analytical. You notice things you missed before.
mind.protocol: Edit, organize, and wrap up loose ends. It's the best time for administrative tasks and deep work.

body.title: Metabolic Burn
body.detail: Your metabolism speeds up (burning ~100-300 more calories), but endurance drops. Heat tolerance is lower.
body.protocol: Switch to strength training with longer rests. Honor your hunger with complex carbs to boost serotonin.

skin.title: Congestion Alert
skin.detail: Progesterone stimulates oil production while pores tighten, leading to trapped bacteria and breakouts.
skin.protocol: Use salicylic acid (BHA) to keep pores clear. Avoid heavy, pore-clogging makeup if possible.
